title: LA passage: Inter ubera mea commorabitur

Inter ubera mea commorabitur

Language: la

anchor.prefix: come away, bidding her look forth, a spouse, from Amana and from the mountains of the leopards; and the soul seemed to answer with the same inaudible voice, surrendering herself:
anchor.suffix:
.

 This idea of surrender had a perilous attraction for his mind now that he felt his soul beset once again by the insistent voices of the flesh which began to murmur to him again
